system.description:
The long hooked or barbed spears carried by Thralls. These cruel weapons are rarely found outside the hands of a Thrall. Many Thralls carry ordinary spears in this design, but more advanced forms have occasionally been identified. Some versions have a monomolecular edge that cuts more easily than any blade manufactured without machine assistance, and others contain strange electro-conductive elements, similar to an Electrospear, but designed to draw upon implants in the wielder’s body. These Thrall ‘Electrospears’ can be used in melee but can also discharge a short-ranged electrical shock.

The profile for Thrall Spears can be found in the Security Weapons Table at the start of this section. Thrall Electrospears are powered weapons, but they do not recharge normally: they draw power from the user’s body.
